history.body: Hi, I’m looking at a few properties around Seberang Jaya and wondering whether Pearl Residences could suit a first rental purchase. Could you give me a general idea of the unit options, pricing and what costs I should factor in?

Hi! Phase 1 has one main residential layout: Type A, 900 sq ft with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony.

The listed base-price references vary by category and floor, roughly RM328k–RM358k. As one dated example, a 14 Aug 2026 snapshot calculates RM301,760 from a RM328k base with the package shown for that category. That’s a historical indicative calculation, not confirmation the package is still valid or an all-in unit price. Car-park premiums and some accessories may also apply, depending on the unit configuration.

For the 900 sq ft layout, maintenance is RM162/month (RM0.18 psf, inclusive of sinking fund)—a useful known recurring cost when you work through rental numbers. The project is freehold, with Phase 1 expected to complete in Q4 2029. These facts don’t establish rental demand or returns, and exact current pricing and other costs need to be checked against a specific unit.

For your first rental purchase, are you mainly looking for monthly rental income, or a longer-term hold?

At the moment I’m mainly considering rental income, though I’m also weighing whether it might make sense as a longer-term hold or for my own use later. I appreciate the clear caveat on returns. Could you confirm what’s included in the current price package and whether there are any regular charges beyond the RM162 maintenance?

The RM162/month maintenance includes the sinking fund. I can’t confirm from the information I have whether there are other regular charges. The pricing reference lists the base price, applicable car-park premiums and possible extras separately, so I wouldn’t assume they’re all included in today’s package. I’ll verify the current package inclusions and any other recurring charges before giving you a definite answer.
